title: AbolDeepIO: A Novel Deep Inertial Odometry Network for Autonomous Vehicles
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems

fulltext_evidence.type: First-author doctoral thesis official DSpace TEXT bitstream, not journal version of record

software_implementation: independent new staging code from method description; no source copied
fidelity: same-named primary-author thesis scalar-core reconstruction with explicit assumptions; not exact journal reproduction

input.clock_dtype: int64 or float64 before conversion to network dtype
input.nominal_clock_fill_policy: forbidden by caller original-clock provenance admission; numeric tensor checks cannot distinguish artificial nominal fill from real uniform acquisition
clock_numeric_checks: original timestamp adjacency strictly increasing before subtraction
difference finite and positive after subtraction; catches integer overflow

indexing_assumption.lookahead_latency: actual next timestamp minus target timestamp

task.path_length: within-window prefix sum of Euclidean position step lengths, meters
task.orientation_chord: within-window prefix sum of quaternion R4 coordinate-chord lengths, dimensionless

loss.reduction: SUM across batch and supervised time; batch reduction unreported

frozen_assumptions: N supervised rows, N+1 real IMU readings; i+1 feature predicts i target; printed indexing unresolved
unidirectional PyTorch LSTM gates and default initialization, not proven historical Keras equivalents
element-wise post-LSTM output dropout; input/recurrent Keras masks unreported
linear outputs with no hidden positivity transform/cumulative output layer
lambda1=lambda2=1 and batch SUM are staging defaults, not recovered numeric author settings
literal raw quaternion coordinates default; optional hemisphere continuity is a named adaptation
acc-noise then gyro-noise then acc/gyro/time/fusion dropout RNG order
no raw-nanosecond scaling; input dtype cast can round large dt and saturate time gates
optimizer/LR/batch/epochs/validation recipe unresolved; no OriNet parameters borrowed
caller must admit original acquisition-clock provenance; dtype/monotonic checks cannot prove that a uniform clock was genuinely acquired
remaining_blockers: journal VoR/author accepted manuscript and exact network/head/window/Keras details
raw-clock preservation: uniform native200Hz timestamps cannot restore original sensor jitter
scalar task data/metrics and standard lifecycle are not integrated
raw nanosecond LSTM saturation and any explicit normalized-time ablation need measured study
any XYZ output needs a different learned direction/vector head and task/loss contract
